name: Brian Fitzpatrick
stance: Signed the bipartisan call for urgent federal guardrails and oversight of advanced AI.

statements.text: This was more than a cyber breach—it was a warning shot. A reported Chinese state-sponsored group used AI to autonomously execute an espionage operation—rapid targeting, independent execution, almost no human touchpoints
One of ten signers of the bipartisan leadership letter urging Congress to act on AI oversight, security and transparency after advanced-AI loss-of-control incidents.

We’re now calling on House leadership to advance the dozens of bipartisan bills already on the table to strengthen AI security, transparency, and independent oversight—and better protect the systems our country depends on.

With the Problem Solvers Caucus AI and Evolving Technologies Working Group, sent a letter ahead of Xi Jinping's visit urging the Administration to implement a coordinated international framework on AI safety and security anchored in American standards for testing and incident reporting.

review.note: added October 2026; signature verified via the lead's primary release
